ticker.pick_prompt: Search or pick a ticker from the sidebar list.
ticker.pct_portfolio_help: EUR market value vs total of all open positions
ticker.unrealised_pl_help: Latest price vs FIFO average cost, fees included
ticker.history_failed: Couldn't load the price history for this ticker — try again in a moment.
ticker.history_empty: No price history available for this ticker — it may be delisted or very thinly traded.
ticker.sma20_help: Price above SMA20 = short-term uptrend, below = downtrend
ticker.crypto_caption: Quoted in {quote}. Fundamentals, insider filings, earnings and DCF don't apply to crypto — those sections are hidden for this asset.
ticker.chart_annual_title: Revenue, net income & diluted EPS by year
ticker.annual_caption: Hatched bars = analyst consensus revenue; dashed = consensus EPS (right axis) with shaded low-high analyst range (yfinance); years beyond published estimates extrapolated (revenue at next-FY consensus growth, EPS at long-term growth with next-FY fallback).
ticker.fundamentals_failed: Couldn't load the fundamental KPIs for this ticker — the data source returned nothing.
ticker.verdict_tags: Verdict tags: :green[cheap / strong / safe] · :orange[fair] · :red[expensive / weak / risky]
ticker.kpi_peg_help: yfinance PEG unreliable — cross-check analyst consensus (Koyfin/TIKR)
ticker.moat_insufficient: Not enough statement history to score a moat — needs at least 3 of the 5 pillars (ROIC, margins, growth, FCF, dilution).
ticker.moat_caption: Quant proxies from {years} filed years — the score sees what a moat leaves in the numbers, not its cause (brand, network effects, switching costs). Screen, not verdict.
ticker.insider_caption: SEC Form 4 — officers, directors and 10% owners trading their own stock. Open-market buys (P) and sells (S) are the signal; grants, option exercises and tax withholding are shown but excluded from the buy/sell net.
ticker.no_form4: No recent Form 4 filings on record (non-US filers have none here).
ticker.cluster_buying: Cluster buying — multiple insiders bought on the open market over the window and net flow is positive.
ticker.selling_dominates: Selling dominates open-market insider flow over the window.
ticker.chart_insider_title: Open-market insider buys vs sells by month ($)
ticker.related_help: People-also-watch peers from Yahoo Finance — tap to add to the comps table.
ticker.medals_caption: 🥇🥈🥉 = best composite rank across the comparable KPIs (valuation, quality, growth, leverage — each metric ranked across the set, size ignored).
ticker.pick_peers: Pick peers to build the comps table.
ticker.kpi_sources_caption: Verification hierarchy: SEC EDGAR (primary, 10-K/10-Q) > stockanalysis.com (10y ratios) > Macrotrends (15-20y trends) > Koyfin/TIKR (multi-company comps). yfinance loads the numbers; EDGAR confirms them. All KPIs defined in {n} entries of KPI_SOURCES.
ticker.pe_insufficient: Couldn't rebuild a P/E history — no quarterly EPS filings available for this ticker (non-US filer without an FMP key, or too few quarters).
ticker.kpi_pe_current_help: Latest close divided by the trailing-12-month diluted EPS known that day, rebuilt from quarterly filings. Can differ slightly from the P/E (TTM) in the fundamentals row (different EPS vintage).
ticker.kpi_pe_avg_help: Mean of the daily trailing P/E over the selected range.
ticker.kpi_pe_premium_help: Premium (+) or discount (−) of the current P/E against its own average over the selected range.
ticker.pe_caption: Reconstructed series: split-adjusted close over the trailing-12-month diluted EPS (GAAP) rebuilt from quarterly filings ({source}), stepped forward on each filing date — each day only uses figures that were already public. Loss-making stretches (negative TTM EPS) are omitted.
ticker.pe_divergence: This reconstructed P/E ({cur}) is {diff}% away from the P/E (TTM) in Fundamentals ({fund}). Usual cause: the latest reported quarter is already in Yahoo's trailing EPS, but its 10-Q/10-K hasn't been filed with SEC EDGAR yet — this series catches up on the filing date. Adjusted vs GAAP EPS can also widen the gap.
